title: Gochujang Chicken and Cheese Tortellini under Melted Fontina
changes_from_base: Shop-bought dried cheese tortellini are stirred into chicken thigh pieces cooked in a honey, gochujang, soy, ginger and sesame glaze, then topped with fontina and browned under the grill instead of a butter sauce.
summary: Sticky, spicy gochujang chicken tumbled with cheese tortellini under a bubbling blanket of melted fontina.
equipment: 30 cm ovenproof frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces
spring onions, thinly sliced on the diagonal

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Turn the grill to high with a shelf roughly 20 cm beneath it.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: In an ovenproof pan, stir together 60 ml honey, 3 tbsp gochujang, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 chopped garlic cloves and 2 tsp grated ginger.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Turn 680 g chicken thigh pieces through the glaze, put a lid on and let them bubble on a medium-high hob for 10-15 min, giving the pan a stir every few minutes, until cooked through.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Meanwhile, bring 2000 ml water to the boil and cook 225 g tortellini until tender, then drain.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat, fold the tortellini into the sticky chicken and cover the top with 225 g grated fontina.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Slide under the grill for 2-5 min, until the cheese has melted and is just starting to bubble, then scatter with 2 sliced spring onions and serve.

tips: Cook the chicken to 74 °C at the centre of the thickest piece.
Read the tortellini and gochujang labels for gluten, egg and soya.
Cut the spring onions on an angle for a crisp, fresh finish.
storage: Best enjoyed fresh from the grill while the cheese is molten. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
